aesthetics: Warm off-white paper and true black ink

typography.instructions: Use Cormorant Garamond for all headings with tracking-tighter and light weights. Use Outfit for body text and JetBrains Mono for accents like numbers (01, 02) or small labels. Avoid Inter/Roboto.

rules: Generous white space: Use p-12, p-16, py-32.
Asymmetry: Left-align layouts, offset images, do not perfectly center everything.
Clipped frames: Wrap product images in containers with overflow-hidden and distinct aspect ratios (e.g. aspect-[3/4] or aspect-[4/5]).
No generic card grids: Use list-like asymmetric grids for products.

patterns: Kinetic Hero: Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion (overflow: hidden, text moving up from translateY(100%)).
Parallax Hero: Subtle image scaling and translation on scroll.
Scroll Reveals: Fade in and slight translate-y on sections as they enter viewport.
Editorial Marquee: Very slow, smooth drift with serif font, text-4xl or larger, low contrast or outline style.
Hover states: Subtle image zoom inside clipped frames, text color shifts.

components.name: Navigation
components.rules: Fixed top nav, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-background/80) or solid background. Logo on left, cart drawer trigger on right.

components.name: Cart Drawer
components.rules: Slide-in from right. Displays added items, quantities, and a large primary CTA button that links to WhatsApp (+5491156011898) with a pre-filled order message.

components.name: Hero Section
components.rules: Massive typography (H1). Masked text reveals. Parallax leather product/model image (e.g., aspect-[3/4] placed asymmetrically).

components.name: Manifesto (Nosotros)
components.rules: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) in mono font. Large serif text describing the brand. Lots of negative space.

components.name: Product Filters
components.rules: Horizontal scrollable or flex-wrap list of 12 categories. Active state styled with a 1px border and pastel pink (#F4C5D6) subtle background or dot.

components.name: Footer
components.rules: Massive spacing (py-32). Address (Soreda 6180, Wilde), Instagram link, WhatsApp link. Dark or light theme, high contrast typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic UI cards for products; design a custom editorial layout with borderless clipped frames (aspect-ratio).
Implement the WhatsApp cart logic: Build a string from cart items and open window.open(`https://wa.me/5491156011898?text=${encodedMessage}`).
Add Lenis for smooth scrolling in a useEffect at the root layout.
Add Framer Motion for scroll reveals (whileInView) and kinetic hero (initial/animate on mount).
Install and use 'react-fast-marquee' for the slow editorial marquee.
Use Google Fonts for Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Use provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text.
